0022600165.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 0-2 on the road, 11th in the West) visit the unbeaten Memphis Grizzlies (5-0, on a five-game winning streak, first in the West) for the Pelicans' seventh game of the 2026-27 season. New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Memphis is missing Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Ty Jerome (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Pelicans won the last meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
